metadata.question: Did the smoke plumes originating from fires in Siskiyou County on August 18, 2021, travel northward for at least 20 miles?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to detect fires and smoke plumes in Siskiyou County, California on August 18, 2021 - Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire data to locate fire sources - Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8 imagery to visualize smoke plumes - Track aerosol optical depth or use visual bands to detect smoke movement 2. Masking strategy: - Should NOT mask clouds heavily as smoke might be mistaken for clouds - Need to identify smoke plumes visually or through aerosol data - Use true color or false color composites to see smoke 3. Logic: - Locate active fires in Siskiyou County on Aug 18, 2021 - Check imagery north of fire locations (20+ miles) for smoke presence - Valid answer: A (smoke traveled 20+ miles north) or B (did not) - C1: No imagery available - C2: No valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation failure ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Siskiyou County geometry (approximate bounds) const siskiyouCounty = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-123.5, 41.2], [-123.5, 42.0], [-121.5, 42.0], [-121.5, 41.2], [-123.5, 41.2]] ]); const targetDate = '2021-08-18'; const dateStart = '2021-08-17'; const dateEnd = '2021-08-19'; // 2. Get active fire data from FIRMS (MODIS) const fires = ee.FeatureCollection('FIRMS') .filter(ee.Filter.date(dateStart, dateEnd)) .filterBounds(siskiyouCounty); const fireCount = fires.size().getInfo(); print(`Active fires detected: ${fireCount}`); if (fireCount === 0) { print("No active fires found in the date range."); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Get fire centroids to establish source locations const fireCentroid = fires.geometry().centroid(); const fireCoords = fireCentroid.coordinates().getInfo(); print(`Fire centroid: [${fireCoords[0].toFixed(3)}, ${fireCoords[1].toFixed(3)}]`); // 4. Create region 20 miles north of fires (20 miles ≈ 32 km ≈ 0.29 degrees) const northRegion = ee.Geometry.Point(fireCoords) .buffer(5000) // 5km buffer .translate(0, 32000); // Move 32km north // 5. Get Sentinel-2 imagery to detect smoke let s2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(siskiyouCounty.union(northRegion)) .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); let s2Count = s2Collection.size().getInfo(); print(`Sentinel-2 images found: ${s2Count}`); // Fallback to Landsat 8 if no Sentinel-2 if (s2Count === 0) { print("Trying Landsat 8..."); const l8Collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(siskiyouCounty.union(northRegion)) .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd); const l8Count = l8Collection.size().getInfo(); print(`Landsat 8 images found: ${l8Count}`); if (l8Count === 0) { print("No imagery available."); print("C1"); return; } const l8Image = l8Collection.first(); const aerosolL8 = l8Image.select('SR_B1'); // Coastal aerosol band const aerosolNorth = aerosolL8.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('SR_B1'); const aerosolValue = aerosolNorth.getInfo(); print(`Aerosol value 20mi north: ${aerosolValue}`); if (aerosolValue === null) { print("C3"); return; } // High aerosol values indicate smoke presence if (aerosolValue > 8000) { print("Smoke detected 20+ miles north of fire source."); print("A"); } else { print("No significant smoke detected 20+ miles north."); print("B"); } return; } // 6. Analyze Sentinel-2 aerosol optical depth const s2Image = s2Collection.first(); const aerosolS2 = s2Image.select('B1'); // Coastal aerosol band const aerosolNorthS2 = aerosolS2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: northRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B1'); const aerosolValueS2 = aerosolNorthS2.getInfo(); print(`Aerosol value (S2) 20mi north: ${aerosolValueS2}`); if (aerosolValueS2 === null) { print("C3"); return; } // Check pixel count const pixelCount = aerosolS2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: northRegion, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('B1').getInfo(); print(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { print("C2"); return; } // High aerosol values indicate smoke (typical threshold > 1000 for S2) if (aerosolValueS2 > 1000) { print("Smoke plume detected 20+ miles north."); print("A"); } else { print("No smoke plume detected 20+ miles north."); print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
